metadata.title: Home
metadata.description: Welcome to Andy Sinker Driving School — expert driving lessons, instructor training, and franchise opportunities.

hero.title: Your journey to safe and confident driving — or a career change — starts here.
hero.lede: Welcome to Andy Sinker Driving School, where we are committed to helping learners become safe, skilled, and confident drivers. Whether you’re a complete beginner, preparing for your driving test, looking to improve your driving skills, or considering a career in driver education, our team is here to support you every step of the way.

audiences.title: For Learners
audiences.body: Structured lessons, mock tests, motorway training, and anxiety support.

audiences.title: For Instructors
audiences.body: ADI training, business launch support, and franchise growth systems.

whyChooseUs.title: Six reasons learners and instructors choose Andy Sinker

items.title: Friendly and Reliable Instructors
items.body: Our professional instructors create a calm, supportive environment where every learner feels comfortable and can progress with confidence.

items.title: Flexible Lesson Times
items.body: Lessons available to suit your schedule, making it easier to fit learning around work, study, or family commitments.

items.title: Tailored to Your Pace
items.body: Structured lessons designed around your individual ability and learning style, so you always progress at the right speed.

items.title: High First-Time Pass Rate
items.body: Our thorough test preparation and structured approach have helped many learners achieve their licence first time.

items.title: Competitive Pricing
items.body: Affordable lessons with support for theory test preparation and fully funded online driving anxiety courses.

items.title: Multi-Award Winning Lead Trainer
items.body: Learn from an industry-recognised trainer, with regular open Zoom sessions where you can ask questions and discuss any concerns.

mission.title: Not just a driving test — a lifetime of safer driving
mission.body: Our goal is not only to help you pass your driving test but to develop the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed for a lifetime of safer driving. We create a positive learning environment where every student can progress comfortably at their own pace and achieve their driving goals.

services.title: Everything you need, from first lesson to career

items.title: Learner Driving Lessons
items.description: From complete beginner to test-ready, with structured plans built around your progress.

items.title: Refresher Lessons
items.description: Rebuild your confidence and sharpen your skills after a break from driving.

items.title: Motorway Driving Training
items.description: Guided motorway sessions to develop the skills needed for high-speed road confidence.

items.title: Mock Driving Tests
items.description: Realistic test-condition practice to prepare you fully for the real thing.

items.title: Pass Plus Courses
items.description: Post-test training to broaden your experience and potentially reduce insurance premiums.

items.title: Instructor Training
items.description: Full ADI Part 1–3 preparation with in-car mentoring and business launch support.

items.title: The Honest Truth Programme
items.description: Promoting safer driving habits for new drivers in the critical period after passing their test.

items.title: Online Anxiety Courses
items.description: Support for driving anxiety, available online and fully funded by the school.

closing.title: Take the first step towards your driving licence
closing.body: Contact us today to discuss your requirements and book your first lesson. We look forward to helping you achieve your goals.
